DVLCA4PLM

Life cycle assessment inside your PLM system

Request a demo

Calculate the environmental impact of your products from the data you already have in PLM. Materials come from CAD and the BOM. They are mapped once to ecoinvent activities and reused.

  • Works with Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill, Dassault ENOVIA and SAP PLM
  • More than 20 impact categories, not only CO₂
  • Supports EN 15804+A2
  • Results and dashboards stored back in PLM
  • Unlimited users, on-premise
